text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Narita Brian on the
training track
talking to some younger
runners.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, you. C'mere for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eek! We're so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Are we in your way?! Sorry! We'll move
right now!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What's going on? Did something
happen?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Nope. Just wanted to talk about that
thing from
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Thing from earlier"? You wanted to talk
to us?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed. An event is scheduled to
take place
at school soon. We intend to
conduct a special
race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We've been searching for test runners
for it as
part of our preparations.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's what this is about? Sorry
for jumping
to conclusions earlier...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's fine. So, would you mind helping us?

And so, the trial run is held  shortly
after...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: YAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sorry! There's no way we can do
this!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Running with her is way too scary!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian! Stop scowling and yelling like
that! This is
only a practice run—tone it
down!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I can turn down the volume, but I can't
turn down
my face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You have a point, but we can't
continue the
trial like this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we can do something about this
image of
yours to prevent further
misunderstandings...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! I've come up with the perfect idea!
You
two—let me share a little story with
you.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: A story?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It will interest you to know that Brian
was quite
the crybaby when she was
little.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey! What the hell?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if she still needs it,
but she wasn't
able to sleep without her stuffed
animal. What
was it called again?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Stop! Why are you saying this?! Have
you lost
your mind?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...The point is, I want you to understand
that
Brian is like any other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She becomes frightened and, as you can
see,
embarrassed—just like the rest of
us. So you don't
have to be afraid of her.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right. I guess we got all
spooked
over nothing.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for that. Okay, we're ready to
run!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever. Let's get on with it already!

With that, they successfully finish their
test run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch, it's been a while since anyone
dared to
humiliate me like that. You've
got some nerve!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Apologies. But if I hadn't, they would
have been
too frightened to run.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The best way to get closer to people is
through laughter. Besides, don't you
think it's good that
they're not afraid of
you anymore?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You sure know how to spin things.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Just know that I'll remember this.
I have a
few stories about you too, Big
Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Like when we went to an amusement
park for the
first time...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on, Brian! Bringing that up is out
of line!
